translation: If the third segment is injured, treat it the same as the second segment; its nail is called the claw nail (爪甲). <ins>Sanyu Heshang Tang</ins> (Dispersing Stasis and Harmonizing Injury Decoction, 散瘀和傷湯) <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏) (both seen in the injury of the vertex bone).
